in_marathi.name: Garjan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sound of thunder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Garjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Garjan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'garjana', which means 'to produce a sound', specifically the sound of thunder. In Hindu mythology, Garjan is the name of a demon, who is the personification of thunder. The name carries the power and energy of nature and the courage and strength of a warrior.
